author: PC Gamer
text:
id co-founder John Carmack revisits Doom at QuakeCon: 'Still a great game after all these years!'
Not a controversial opinion, by any means.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Bethesda 40th anniversary sale knocks 50% off Doom: The Dark Ages - Revelations just a month after launch
The whole catalogue is discounted, but this one really stood out to me.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The indie parkour game from one of the French brothers behind 2024's best FPS is coming out in just two weeks
Mirror's Edge, Hot Lava, and surf map enjoyers may want to keep an eye on Vholume.

author: PC Gamer
text:
WoW developers reflect on Midnight's first season—a world without AddOns, task overload, and Prey
Curse of Ul'atek comes out next week, but how has Midnight's first season gone in the eyes of its devs?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Forget Quake, Worms: The Director's Cut just got a free expansion for the series' 30th anniversary
Creator Andy Davidson hopes it gives the game "a new lease on life."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Stop waiting for the Game of Thrones CRPG of your dreams and settle for the pleasant eurojank compromise instead
It's rough, dated and still probably one of the better GoT games.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Blocky zombie survival sim Unturned releases its source code so players can build a 'lasting legacy' for the game 'regardless of the changes we make'
The source files are freely available for non-commercial use.

author: PC Gamer
text:
God of War TV series sees further recasts as Amazon seeks older actors for Atreus and Thrud
The series will have different actors in these roles for Season 2.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Tencent's cyberpunk rival to Grand Theft Auto is in trouble as its developer lays off 80 people
Lightspeed LA says it will "shift the creative and development direction" of Last Sentinel.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Big Walk: So, what's the deal with that number puzzle?
If you're stuck on this early puzzle, we can give you some hints—or the complete solution.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6's Netflix deal forces us to ask: can you pirate an advertisement?
Just when you thought videogame marketing couldn't get sillier, people are going to wind up stealing a trailer.

author: PC Gamer
text:
FromSoftware sleuth unearths earliest footage of Demon's Souls to date: A prototype with a first person camera mode
Demon's Field.

author: PC Gamer
text:
From ancient Buddhism, to iconic manga hair, to Keanu Reeves: a PC Gamer Causality Chain™
Would Xuanzang have liked John Wick?

author: PC Gamer
text:
BioWare veteran says Baldur's Gate 3 was such a great sequel because it didn't try to be too much like Baldur's Gate 2
Mark Darrah thinks Larian succeeded because it wasn't afraid to do its own thing.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Even with an $80 price tag, 'Grand Theft Auto 6 will be an incredible bargain,' Take-Two boss says
Strauss Zelnick reckons that the quality of the experience will more than justify the price.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Take-Two CEO says he expects the games industry to be in 'commercial streaming mode within 3 years,' which is great news if you hate owning things
Rockstar's parent company believes cloud gaming will grow its customer base even as hardware prices rise.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Big Walk patch addresses voice volume complaints with restraint: 'We consider it an important part of the game's design that you can only hear players who are close to you'
A new update "makes quiet voices louder overall," but doesn't let you hear players from farther away.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Japan has reportedly asked the US to stop using Mario, Pokemon, and others in social media posts
It's not just about the sanctity of copyright law anymore—Japan's foreign ministry is apparently worried that the US government is damaging the brands.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Take-Two boss dismisses hand-wringing over the end of disc-based games: 'Our business is well over 90% digitally distributed as it is'
Strauss Zelnick says Take-Two will still put out physical editions "now and then," but for the most part, the era of games on discs is already over.
